parts.title: The Morning Walk and the Dangerous Disciplinarian

series.summary: Rentaro starts his morning dating both Hakari and Karane, walking hand-in-hand to school while dodging the terrifying Vice Principal.

segments.voiceover_text: Rentaro wakes up to an unbelievable new reality: after suffering one hundred painful rejections, he is now officially dating two gorgeous soulmates simultaneously.
On their morning walk to school, Rentaro holds hands with Hakari and Karane, flustered as both girls affectionately switch to first names.
At the school gates, the girls cling possessively to his arms, instantly drawing the predatory glare of the academy's terrifying Vice Principal.
The grotesque disciplinarian charges forward to punish public affection, but Rentaro shields them boldly, unaware of the explosive romantic dilemma waiting inside.

parts.title: The Rooftop Bento Duel and the Pocky Trap

series.summary: Upon discovering Rentaro has never had his first kiss, Hakari and Karane wage war on the rooftop with homemade bentos and a Pocky game trap.

segments.voiceover_text: During a quiet conversation in class, Rentaro casually admits that he has never kissed anyone before, sending immediate shockwaves through both Hakari and Karane.
At lunchtime on the sunny rooftop, Hakari unveils an elaborate gourmet bento, playfully attempting to feed Rentaro to steal the upper hand.
Panicking at being outdone, Karane furiously shoves her own rolled omelette directly into his mouth, turning lunch into a high-stakes culinary duel.
Hakari swiftly counters by whipping out a box of Pocky for a seductive kissing game, leaving Karane scrambling desperately to protect his lips.

parts.title: The First Kiss Crisis and the Blindfolded Dice Game

series.summary: To prevent favoritism and heartache, Rentaro invents a sensory-deprivation dice game to decide his first kiss under strict anonymity.

segments.voiceover_text: Rentaro sees through their escalating schemes and realizes that surrendering his first kiss to either girl will crush the other's heart.
Hakari suggests settling the matter with rock-paper-scissors, but Karane furiously objects, refusing to let something as sacred as a first kiss depend on luck.
Determined to stay completely fair, Rentaro devises an elaborate randomized contest, strapping on a blindfold and blaring headphones while rolling dice in secret.
With Rentaro completely helpless in sensory deprivation, Hakari rolls the winning number and leans in close, but their fragile truce is already fracturing.

parts.title: Jealous Chaos and the Vice Principal Kiss Sacrifice

series.summary: When the dice contest devolves into tears and jealousy, a guilt-ridden Rentaro sprints to sacrifice his first kiss to the terrifying Vice Principal.

segments.voiceover_text: Before Hakari's lips can make contact, Karane's overwhelming jealousy boils over, physically dragging her back and igniting a fierce, tearful shouting match.
Ripping off his blindfold, Rentaro is utterly devastated to see his beloved soulmates weeping, blaming himself entirely for pitting them against each other.
To extinguish their bitter rivalry once and for all, Rentaro makes a radical vow: neither girl will ever be forced to suffer second place.
Sprinting frantically into the school hallway, Rentaro charges straight toward the grotesque Vice Principal with puckered lips, preparing an unthinkable sacrifice to save them.

parts.title: True Devotion and the Legendary Three-Way Kiss

series.summary: Hakari and Karane rescue Rentaro from his grotesque sacrifice, realize their shared love, and seal their bond with an unprecedented three-way kiss.

segments.voiceover_text: Terrified that Rentaro will surrender his virgin lips to a monster, Hakari and Karane join forces, miraculously driving the horrifying Vice Principal away.
Regrouping on the rooftop, the girls confront Rentaro, deeply moved that he was honestly willing to sacrifice his dignity just to protect their feelings.
Realizing their mutual devotion to their boyfriend and each other, Hakari and Karane cast aside their rivalry, accepting that their love must be shared.
Stepping forward together in a triangular embrace, the trio locks lips simultaneously, completing a hilarious yet beautiful three-way kiss that unites them forever.

parts.title: Sisterly Harmony and the Electric Third Soulmate

series.summary: After bonding through their shared kiss, the trio visits the library, where Rentaro experiences a soul-shattering ZING with quiet bookworm Shizuka.

segments.voiceover_text: Blushing furiously in the warm aftermath of their synchronized kiss, Hakari and Karane discover an unexpected closeness, cementing an affectionate sisterly partnership alongside Rentaro.
Seeking a peaceful refuge after an exhausting day of romantic chaos, the happy trio visits the school library to browse the quiet, sunlit shelves.
Reaching toward a book on a high wooden shelf, Rentaro gently brushes fingers with an intensely shy, petite girl buried behind a thick fantasy novel.
Their gazes interlock, and an electrifying jolt of cosmic destiny shocks Rentaro to his core—introducing his adorable third girlfriend, Shizuka Yoshimoto!
